meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Performs constraint-based metabolic modeling with COBRApy, including FBA, pFBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, growth media, production envelopes, gap filling, and SBML model validation for systems biology and metabolic engineering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用通量分析与基因敲除模拟代谢网络,预测菌株生长与产量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做代谢工程或系统生物学,需要模拟细胞的代谢通量。
copy.tagline_en: Run flux balance analysis to predict strain growth, yields, and knockout effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in metabolic engineering or systems biology and model cell metabolism.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可载入、构建或导出代谢模型（SBML 等格式），运行 FBA、FVA、基因敲除、通量采样、培养基优化等分析，输出生长速率与通量结果。
howto.when: 当你要求载入或构建基因组尺度代谢模型、跑 FBA/FVA、做基因或反应敲除等分析时触发。

say.text: 载入 textbook 模型，跑一次 FBA 看生长速率
say.note: 输出目标值与各反应通量

say.text: 对这个模型做单基因敲除，找出必需基因
say.note: 返回敲除后生长低于阈值的基因

say.text: 算一下这个模型的最小培养基
say.note: 给出满足目标生长所需的最少组分

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can load, build or export metabolic models (SBML, JSON, YAML) and run FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling and media optimization, returning growth rates and flux values.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to load or build a genome-scale metabolic model, run FBA or FVA, or do gene/reaction knockout screens.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model and run FBA to see the growth rate
Run single gene deletions and find the essential genes
say_en.note: Flags genes whose knockout drops growth

say_en.text: Compute the minimal medium for this model
say_en.note: Gives the fewest required medium components
